description: This file defines React-like components (using Qwik framework) for displaying a list of notes, incorporating features like toolbar actions, grid or list layouts, and individual note cards and rows with edit/delete functionality.

methods.name: NoteCard
methods.description: Component that renders a note in card format with title, content excerpt, tags, and action buttons for editing and deleting.

methods.name: NoteRow
methods.description: Component that renders a note in a row layout with title, content, and action buttons for editing and deleting.
